name: trace events category lifecycle
source: import { createTracing, getEnabledCategories } from 'node:trace_events'; function main(): void { const tracing = createTracing({ categories: ['node'] }); console.log(tracing.enabled); tracing.enable(); console.log(tracing.enabled, String(getEnabledCategories()).includes('node')); tracing.disable(); console.log(tracing.enabled); }
